main.description: A thread beside a text channel. The space key is the thread's identity. The thread's shared metadata is the garden.msg.thread record at key 'self' inside it, and Colibri's own thread settings are the social.colibri.beta.thread.settings record at key 'self'. The community writes both, so a thread cannot claim a channel its community did not put it in.
main.name: Colibri thread
